answer: At 32 units per epoch, sustaining 32 aliases for 55 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. The fee is charged through an anchor debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the dawn totals, and the gale anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
